messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — GPU node queue length > 600 for 7m across cluster 'gpu-prod-eu'. Autoscaler errors detected. Severity: P2. @sam (oncall) paged.

sam (oncall): on it, acknowledging. seeing high enqueue on inference-queue. are we dropping traffic? any customer visible errors?

carol (support): multiple customers reporting 503s and timeouts for embeddings and chat endpoints starting ~20m ago. tickets #4621 #4622.

leah (eng-sre): checking autoscaler logs, past 10m shows repeated failures creating nodegroup: "AutoScalingGroup update failed: LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch" then a cascade of "InstanceLaunch error: iam:PassRole denied" in some attempts. snippet:```2026-03-15T09:12:02Z autoscaler: error create nodegroup: UnauthorizedOperation: iam:PassRole on LaunchTemplate v76```

miguel (infra): if it's iam:PassRole that's usually the instance profile/attach-role path. Did a config drift run happen in the last deploy? I see a launch-template update 09:05UTC with new instance profile arn:aws:iam::111:role/gpu-node-role-v2.

maya (ml-serv): interesting — model routing already falling back to smaller variants but queue still growing because we hit GPU capacity, CPU variants can't keep up for embeddings.

ds (eng-runtime): tagging in: autoscaler also logged ASG max size reached on one pool: "Requested capacity 50 > max 50" for pool gpu-pool-west. So some pools are at ASG limit, others failing on IAM. Two independent blockers.

sam (oncall): plan: 1) triage IAM denials with infra, 2) temporarily increase ASG max for gpu-pool-west if quota permits, 3) evict non-prod GPU jobs and free nodes, 4) surface customer impact. I'm enabling incident channel.

miguel (infra): investigating IAM. running: ```aws iam get-role --role-name gpu-node-role-v2``` returns role exists but trust policy missing ec2.amazonaws.com principal in one account - looks like drift. Should be:```{ "Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"ec2.amazonaws.com"} }```

leah (eng-sre): while infra looks at drift, I can manually create nodes from existing working LT in another region and k8s will schedule, but cross-region latency bad. Also we can temporarily bump ASG max via console: `asg update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-west --max-size 70` — will someone approve?

miguel (infra): I need a thumbs up, but also raising that we might hit account EC2 quota. I'll check limits.

carol (support): customers asking for ETA. two enterprise customers are in a workflow-run state; they reported increased latency and failures. Please call out in status page if you think this will be >30m.

sam (oncall): setting status page draft: "Degradation for GPU-powered endpoints. Engineering investigating autoscaler failures; mitigation in progress." Will update.

maya (ml-serv): mitigation idea: enable model-level hard-limits to reject oversized batch/stream requests to shed load while capacity returns. Can we flip that quickly? It's a config change in configstore.

leah (eng-sre): doing quick triage commands: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep CrashLoop` shows many pending/gpu-request pods. `kubectl describe pod <one>` shows scheduler failed: 0/200 nodes available: 200 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.

sam (oncall): manual steps underway: 1) miguel to patch the role trust policy or roll back LT; 2) leah to bump ASG max for gpu-pool-west + scale out a few nodes; 3) maya to apply model shedding config; 4) dave to watch runtime for KV cache thrash.

miguel (infra): patched trust policy to include ec2 service and re-applied. Also found the launch template version points to an instance-profile arn that doesn't exist in account B — cross-account deployment misconfigured. Rolling LT rollback to v75. Command: `aws ec2 modify-launch-template --launch-template-id lt-0abc --default-version 75`

incident-bot: Deploybot: Launch template rollback to v75 initiated by miguel at 09:28 UTC.

leah (eng-sre): after rollback, autoscaler logs show new create attempts succeed for some pools, but gpu-pool-west still blocked on ASG limit. I'll bump the max- size now.

leah (eng-sre): ran: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-west --max-size 80 --desired-capacity 70` — API success. Nodes starting.

ops-bot: ASG gpu-pool-west scaled to 70 instances (requested) at 09:33 UTC.

maya (ml-serv): I'm enabling model shedding config: toggled `max_batch_tokens` down and `reject_when_queue>300`. Rolling out to prod now.

dave (eng-runtime): seeing KV cache hit rate drop then recover. streaming latencies improving on canary routes.

carol (support): customer updates sent: "We're mitigating an autoscaling issue affecting GPU-backed endpoints; partial recovery in progress. ETA update 15m."

sam (oncall): quick health checks: request success rate for gpu endpoints improved from 72% -> 91% in last 10m. Queue length down from >600 -> ~120. Still above typical.

miguel (infra): note: we must follow up with an IAM audit and prevent future LT cross-account drift. Creating infra ticket #INF-908 with root cause summary.

leah (eng-sre): also logging autoscaler action: adding alert to detect ASG at 90% of max and auto-suggest increasing desired or ticketing.

maya (ml-serv): recommend we keep model shedding on for 30m and then gradually roll back while observing.

sam (oncall): handing to leah for post-mitigation monitoring and to miguel for infra remediation. I'll remain assigned for incident communications for 30m. @carol keep customer comms updated.

carol (support): will update tickets and send one follow-up to affected customers once stable.

leah (eng-sre): closing the active pager — mitigation successful but follow-ups required: infra IAM audit, ASG max alert, LT version gating. Filing a post-incident note. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Pager resolved at 09:56 UTC by leah (eng-sre). Duration: 44m.
